topbarTitle: Manulife Investment Management on AEM Edge Delivery
topbarSubtitle: Institutional site demo: authoring, performance, personalization and experimentation

slides.slideTitle: Your institutional site, rebuilt on Edge Delivery
slides.leadParagraph: The Manulife IM Taiwan institutional homepage, capabilities, sustainability, viewpoints and contact pages, running on AEM Edge Delivery Services with your brand.
bulletPoints: Brand tokens: Manulife green, navy and coral
Open-font substitute for Manulife JH Sans with serif italic emphasis
Same IA: Capabilities, Viewpoints, About Us, Sustainability, Contact Us
slides.keyTakeaways: Built in hours from a reusable base, not months.

slides.slideTitle: Authors edit in Document Authoring, like a document
slides.leadParagraph: Every page is a document in DA. Blocks such as hero, cards, tabs, table and form are simple tables authors already understand.
bulletPoints: Edit the fixed-income page and preview in seconds
Reuse variants: hero banner, cards text, list and stats
No developer needed for new pages
slides.keyTakeaways: Marketing owns the content lifecycle end to end.

slides.leadParagraph: Edge Delivery serves pre-rendered HTML from the edge with optimized images and no build step, so Core Web Vitals stay green as the site grows.
slides.keyTakeaways: Faster pages mean better engagement and SEO.

slides.slideTitle: A/B test the homepage hero in minutes
slides.leadParagraph: The homepage runs an experiment: the brand hero versus the L&G partnership announcement. Use the Experimentation overlay to simulate each variant.
slides.keyTakeaways: Authors create variants as documents. No tickets, no deploys.

slides.leadParagraph: A Credit without boundaries campaign swaps the homepage for visitors arriving from that campaign, driven by a URL or UTM parameter.
slides.keyTakeaways: Personalize by campaign without new templates.

slides.leadParagraph: A compounding calculator on multi-asset solutions and a spreadsheet-driven contact form show how interactive experiences are authored, not coded.
slides.keyTakeaways: Forms are a spreadsheet; calculators are reusable blocks.
